task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to CUP location, pick up CUP, then navigate to TABLE location and place CUP on TABLE
assumptions: CAR robot is available and operational
CUP is graspable and within interaction distance after navigation
TABLE is within interaction distance after navigation for placing
CUP is initially not held by any robot
CAR is not holding any object initially
rtdl: def task PickCupAndPlaceOnTable(;){ state nav_to_cup_success: bool; state nav_to_cup_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav_to_table_success: bool; state nav_to_table_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_cup_success,message->nav_to_cup_msg); check(nav_to_cup_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-1.9995349294939333,y=1.9999986664278404,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_table_success,message->nav_to_table_msg); check(nav_to_table_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP",location_name="TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
